d: Bihar men ek taraph jahan 'indiya' gathbandhan chunav aayog aur kathit vot chori ke khilaph morcha khole hue hai, vahin bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ne bhi patna ki sarkon par utarkar bara javabi hamla bol diya hai. bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ke netritv men patna ke kargil chauk se jepi golanbar (maurya hotal) tak bhajpa ka vishal "loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao" padyatra abhiyan nikala gaya. hathon men bhajpa ka jhanda thame mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne upmukhyamantri vijay kumar sinha, bihar bijepi pradesh adhyaksh sanjay saravgi, mantri dilip jayasval aur varishth neta…
